Team —

We have the NovaCorp workshop at their Seattle office on Tue 10/6 (exec roundtable + hands-on demos). Logistics ask: they need all demo hardware + two crates of printed collateral and swag to arrive on Mon 10/5 between 9am–12pm local. Can Ops confirm:

- Final crate count/weights and dims
- Whether we can consolidate sample laptops + peripherals into a single padded crate (to reduce customs entries)
- Who will be the on-site courier contact for delivery acceptance (NovaCorp will provide a name but we need ours confirmed)

I'm attaching the current packing list (packing_list_v3.xlsx). Please coordinate with QuickShip (ops@quickship.com) and EventServices (dana.liu@eventservices.co) if needed.

Action: Marissa, can you confirm pickup window and whether we need a commercial invoice for this domestic/intl mix? Stephanie — can you confirm the final swag count (branded notebooks, 50; polos, 20; stickers, 200)? Karthik — please flag any model-specific rack mounts that need foam inserts.

Thanks — I want this as low-friction as possible; Nova's execs expect quick setup.

Cheers,
Lauren

> We have the NovaCorp workshop at their Seattle office on Tue 10/6 ...

Thanks Lauren — I spoke with our kit warehouse. Current status:

- Crates: we can do 2 crates (crate A: demo hardware + mounts; crate B: collateral + swag). Estimated gross weights: Crate A = 78 lbs (48x30x18 in), Crate B = 42 lbs (36x24x18 in).
- Consolidation: We can fit the demo laptops and peripherals into Crate A with foam separators — recommend this for safety.
- Commercial invoice: Because the laptops are loaner units that will return to the US shipper, QuickShip advises a pro-forma/commercial invoice for cross-border paperwork (NovaCorp will be importing to WA but some items shipped from our CA warehouse).

Attached is the crate_manifest_novacorp.pdf — it has SKUs and serials.

Pickup window I requested: Mon 10/5, 6am–10am PST (flexible). QuickShip asked for earliest possible confirmation by EOD today so they can reserve a liftgate truck.

Marissa
